args.note: This is wave 7 group 6 part 1 (wave 12), the real problems left by groups 1-5; part 2 (wave 13) is 'polish' (words and layout) and runs after this wave is merged, on top of your logic. The three areas (leftovers7-merge, leftovers7-session, leftovers7-web) were built from a triage of every leftover of groups 1-5 checked against the code at fa1a86f: /tmp/frbench/wave7g6-triage.json (items[] with sources, category, evidence and test_idea; owner_questions; live_checks; dropped). Your area spec is in /tmp/frbench/phaseE.json areas by key, and shared_files there says who owns which part of a file the three areas (and polish later) touch: leftovers7-merge and leftovers7-session were split from one area and are disjoint by file except task-words.ts, runtime.md and the append-only real-daemon.test.ts / fake-daemon.ts. Groups 1 (merge-record, budget-stop, polish-desktop), 2 (dependent-branches, credential-limits), 3 (merge-in-app, credential-chooser, cost, merged-copy), 4 (budget-resume, web-search) and 5 (merged-actions, sites) are merged; group 5's merge ends at fa1a86f, the base of this wave, and CI (Windows and Linux) and the Desktop app workflow are green on it. For each problem, first confirm it at HEAD with a failing test at the person's boundary (the triage's evidence may be stale or wrong: if you cannot make it fail, say so in not_done with the evidence instead of changing code). Then fix it. The earlier groups' full reports are in /tmp/frbench/wave7g1-result.json to wave7g5-result.json when you need the detail behind a triage item. ADRs: merge-record 0111 (dependent-branches and merge-in-app amended it), budget-stop 0112 (cost and budget-resume amended it), the credential order and waits 0100 (credential-limits and credential-chooser amended it), research reading web pages 0107 (web-search and sites amended it), the copy following every merge and Local only 0113 (merged-actions amended it), a repository for a project without one 0097 (merged-actions amended it): amend the right one where behaviour changes. Since group 3, no autonomy level frees a merge: the project's merge mode decides (packages/runtime/src/loop/merge-mode.ts, 'you' by default, 'after_review'), so a test that needs a session to merge sets merge_mode 'after_review'. Hand-overs to reuse rather than duplicate: PrExecutor setAsideWork/bringBack and the refs refs/forerunner/wip/<task>, set-aside-wip/<task>, failed/<task>; GitOps commitAllExcept, applyCommitted, resetHard, subjectsBetween, deleteRemoteBranch, fetchRef, worktreeAdd, worktreeRemove, revert(commits, {mainline}), commitsNotIn; PrTaskExecutor.takeOut/takeOutPlan; migration 0007's merge_record take_out_* columns (MergeRecordRepo.pin clears them); ProjectDocs previews under withCopy; packages/runtime/src/daemon/cancel-words.ts and take-out-words.ts for any new sentence's style; task-words.ts isDockerCard/isRepositoryOffer/isTakeOutNotice/holdsTask/mergedDisplay; web: WebReadRules {mode, only, never}, webAccessOf/cleanSiteList in wiring/web-access.ts, the SDK tool server (agent/sdk.ts SDK_TOOL_SERVER, PostToolUse updatedToolOutput / updatedMCPToolOutput), ChooserFacts.subscriptionPages and keySearchOff, webSearchListsOf; a model call with worst-case money on top of its tokens calls beforeModelCall(ctx, wholeEstimate, tokensOnlyEstimate); any provider wrapper passes ModelProvider.serverWebSearch through. Open owner questions (wave7g6-triage.json owner_questions, and the older ones in docs/status/handoff/NEXT-SESSION.md, e.g. W6-23, U-078, U-037 defaults) are not decided: build nothing that answers one; keep today's behaviour there and list it in not_done. Words: polish owns the wording in shared files and runs after you. Change logic and the state the words read; where a new sentence is unavoidable, follow design section 5 (one sentence read at a glance, CHF only, no ids) and name it in notes_for_other_areas so polish can review it. Security in every area: never weaken the hooks or the sandbox (leftovers7-web's browser sandbox fix is a security boundary: the fallback happens only on an error that names the sandbox), page and search text never becomes instructions, the page reader never reaches this PC or the home network. Polish (wave 13) builds on your work: name in your report every function or file it depends on and every sentence you added or changed, and list your leftovers precisely. The live checks after the merge are in /tmp/frbench/phaseE7-live.md and phaseE7-live-extra.md, and the triage's live_checks list which of them need new steps: write your live_check steps to match.
